liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue up by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.
Debt due within one year was stable at {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, so cash and cash-like investments cover the near-term maturities without new funding.

Free cash flow after lease payments fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, and FCF after leases to debt dropped by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}}, the comparable measure of cash left for debt holders.

Customer prepayments grew, with contract liabilities up by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}}, while advance ticket cover eased by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2024}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}; the group also issued a euro-denominated guaranteed bond under its EMTN programme.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: free cash flow after lease payments fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, and FCF after leases to debt dropped by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}}.

Investment: capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}, above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@FY2024}}, with significant investment in spares to limit aircraft grounding.
Profitability: the EBITDA margin of {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}} is the weakest of the low-cost group ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2024}}), below the peer median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@FY2024}}.
Unit costs: CASK rose by {{cask.change@FY2024}} to {{cask@FY2024}} and CASK ex-fuel by {{cask_ex_fuel.change@FY2024}} to {{cask_ex_fuel@FY2024}}, so the cost base moved against the group.
